text: Not well made/bonded. The forks are a bit tough to clean. The 1st fork I used splintered on the bottom of the handle and on one of the tines of the fork. Not fun to deal with either. Not well made/bonded. The straw in the same set swelled at the bottom after using it, making it a bit more tough to clean. The cleaning brushes are pretty sturdy and held up through use.
